profile.headline: Software Engineer at TeamSense
profile.summary: I am a Computer Engineer with a passion for the development of software that matters. Although I work mostly with technologies written in Java, I consider myself a software development enthusiast, always looking for new frameworks and technologies to learn. I have worked in many software projects as a developer, advisor, mentor, and lead.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead member of the Computational Programming team in charge of the product's core music
recommendations platform.

positions.title: Chief Architect
positions.description: Analyze and plan the technical direction of the company looking for new, emerging and existing open source technologies that can best suit current and prospect customer.

positions.title: Programming Supervisor
positions.description: Responsible for the design and implementation of new capital software projects.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Hired to prepare and make production ready the Civil Registry Application of the Dominican Republic Junta Central Electoral.

Accomplishments: After 6 months of adding new features and fixing issues on the application, successfully deployed application more than 50% of the nations districts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led engineers on the delivery of new software projects for clients from the public and private sector of Puerto Rico. Responsible for the design and implementation of software projects as well as for the planning and management of resources. 

Accomplishments: Promoted to a supervisor position very quickly mostly due to the leadership skills demonstrated during the development of critical software projects for the business.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Collaborated on the development of several key components of the companies VoIP solution 

Accomplishments: Developed API that served as an abstraction layer between the phone's applications and Java Swing using XML as a simple object description manifest. Developed services for retrieving information from several content providers like Yellow Pages Inc. which were used to present content on the phone.

projects.title: Registro Criminal Integrado
projects.description: Implemented the new Criminal Registry of Puerto Rico for the Department of Justice which replaced a legacy software used for more than 20 years. The system encompasses the Prosecutor’s Case Management and Criminal Records Management.

projects.title: Enterprise Integration Services
projects.description: Implemented an Enterprise Service Bus used for the integration of distributed applications to the company’s core banking system. Developed using open source technologies, Apache Servicemix, Apache Camel and Apache ActiveMQ, the system has grown from exposing only several web services to exposing almost 50 web services and consuming data from diﬀerent data sources like databases and messaging systems.
